_sobre: Direção visual e cenas simuladas para a Apoteose, inspiradas nos prompts reais do ChatGPT (docs/product/referencia-prompts-chatgpt-apoteose.md). Servem aos testes da direção de arte (docs/product/direcao-de-arte-imagens.md); não são saída de IA.

visualDirection.finish: Realistic editorial photography with analogue grain and a tactile screen-print finish; visible pores and fabric texture.
visualDirection.atmosphere: Urban, intimate, sensual and irreverent Brazilian party behaviour.
visualDirection.graphics: Sparse organic cut-paper shapes in electric cyan laid over the photo like printed cut-outs.
visualDirection.avoid: parade costumes, feathers, masks, confetti, flags, generic palm trees, festival crowds
